_README: Hand-authored overrides. Anything set here wins over values parsed from the visual guides. The build never rewrites this file. Every override must carry a _why.

manifest.organization: THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD
manifest.audience: Any AI agent, assistant, or automated tool creating, editing, or reviewing work for THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD.
manifest.governance: This system changes one way: a proposed edit in writing, approval by Joel Zimmer and Nathan Zimmer, a version bump, and a changelog entry. No silent edits.
manifest.usage: Free to read, quote, and follow for work produced for or about THE WORD FOR ALL THE WORLD. Not a license to use the wordmark, photography, or video for any other purpose.

_why.updated: ISO date of the last published change to the brand system. The /brand-release skill bumps this on every release. Set it to null to fall back to the Brand Guide's issued date, which is coarser.

tokens._why: Empty by design. Colors, type, and system tokens are read from the Brand Guide so the two can never disagree. Add an entry here only to publish a machine-only value that has no place on the visual page, and say why.

lint._why: Gradient stops used only in the guides' own placeholder panels, which stand in for full-bleed field footage until the footage is cut. The Brand Guide labels them as non-brand placeholders. Remove each one from this list as its panel is replaced with real footage.

_extraPagesWhy: URLs outside this repository that agents should treat as part of the brand system. Each entry: {"title": "...", "url": "...", "note": "..."}.
